description: Plan-coverage-check sidecar — records whether a plan's fix slate covers its audit oracle. Lives at the plan-derivable state/plan-sidecars/<plan-stem>.plan-coverage-check.md home (moved out of docs/plans/ by docs/plans/2026-07-24-g2-plan-pipeline-sidecar-contract.md C11/D0). applies_to covers both canonical *.plan-coverage-check.md and legacy *.md.plan-coverage-check.md forms (globToRegex [^/]* spans embedded dots). verdict is NOT required — some legacy sidecars omit it.

plan.description: Repo-relative path to the plan this coverage check covers.

author.description: Agent that ran the coverage check.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Not enumerated — values vary.

verdict.description: Coverage verdict (e.g. COMPLETE, INCOMPLETE). Not required — legacy sidecars may omit.

title.description: Human-readable label for this coverage check sidecar.
